title: Miniaturized Electronic Circuits, US3138743A
lineage: Issued patent is a historical public disclosure; figures do not independently identify the actual September 1958 physical specimen. The description of germanium and gold wires relates explicitly to the separate preceding multivibrator embodiment.

passages.note: Issued 23 June 1964; Figs. 8a–8c and description disclose a phase-shift oscillator with a semiconductor transistor and distributed RC network.
